Interface SessionAwareMessageListener

All Superinterfaces:
jakarta.jms.MessageListener
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface SessionAwareMessageListener extends jakarta.jms.MessageListener
A MessageListener that also receives the Session that consumed the message, so that it can reply, commit or roll back on that session.

Only JMSListener calls onMessage(Message, Session), and it checks the session with checkSession(Session) before it consumes any message. This interface extends MessageListener so that it can be passed to the JMSListenerRegistry register methods, but it cannot be used as a plain MessageListener: onMessage(Message) throws, so a decorator that delegates to it or MessageConsumer.setMessageListener would fail on every message.

A JMS session is single threaded: use the session only inside onMessage, on the calling thread. For that reason, JMSListener rejects this listener when it is registered with an executor.

Since:
5.2.0

      default void checkSession(jakarta.jms.Session session) throws jakarta.jms.JMSException
      Checks that this listener can handle the messages of a session, before JMSListener consumes any of them. By default, any session is accepted.
      Parameters:
      session - the session of the listener
      Throws:
      jakarta.jms.JMSException - if the session cannot be checked
      IllegalStateException - if this listener cannot use the session
